findings.effect: The spec omits the tool-call part that the real provider sends for a cut-off tool call, so it covers a stream shape production cannot reach. With the real stream shape, raw JSON parser text reaches the pro as a tool error and is stored for the model to read on the next turn.
The backend adds a truncated flag but no visible English or Spanish message for a cut-off turn. Unless the frontend reads that flag and displays a message, the turn remains silent.
